verdict.rationale: Asana documents an official MCP server. The docs cover using it, a list of supported MCP clients, a developer-console flow for registering MCP apps, and a tools reference with read and interactive tools. A probe confirmed the MCP server documentation page is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and explicit evidence of endpoint/transport and auth setup details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Asana to your favorite AI assistants, automation tools, and enterprise platforms
You'll pre-register your MCP app in the developer console, where you can create both standard API apps and MCP apps.
Create and manage tasks and projects through natural language
Interactive tools render a confirmation UI before committing a change. These are currently available in Claude and ChatGPT.
